review_candidates.title: Backend Lead - Python
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Scope As a Backend Team Leader at blnk, you will be primarily responsible for managing a team of senior and junior software engineers and will be reporting directly to the Backend Division manager. Manage your team in conducting requirements analysis and software design. Qualifications Education: Bachelors/master’s in computer science or computer engineering. Experience Minimum of 5 years of experience. Good command of Linux OS and basic administration skills.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Manage your team in conducting requirements analysis and software design. You should have proficient technical skills in the following as a minimum: Programming using C++, Python, PHP, and other similar interpreted scripting languages Building applications using C++ Framework and Postgres and/or MySQL Work with dockers and containers Use GIT repositories Deploy applications on Linux OS and its stack of frameworks and middleware. Qualifications Education: Bachelors/master’s in computer science or computer engineering. Experience Minimum of 5 years of experience.
